question: Which exact upstream weight writers and downstream weight readers couple to the aspectual, tense, joint, and task-exclusive L9H1/H4 value subspaces?

authority.subspace_result_terminal: valid null: shared cosine>=0.80 basis absent, task-typed bases and compact sufficient joint basis retained

frozen_design.gauge: QR only within each stored span; task-exclusive bases are the nonzero SVD span of (I-P_other)U_task at relative tolerance 1e-6
frozen_design.upstream_read_map: U.T times the concatenated block9 H1/H4 c_v row weights
frozen_design.upstream_writers: normalized Frobenius contractions of that read map with every attention-head c_proj slice and MLP output factor in layers 0-8
frozen_design.downstream_state: concatenated block9 H1/H4 c_proj columns times U, orthonormalized without changing span
frozen_design.downstream_readers: exact attention q/k/q2/k2/v/o/ov contractions and restricted bilinear MLP tensors in layers 10-17

predictions.pred_a_authority_basis_gauge_and_exact_c: authority hashes and ranks 18/3/15 recur; all five derived bases and exact contractions are finite and gauge-valid; inventory is 81 upstream heads, 9 upstream MLPs, 72 downstream heads, and 8 downstream MLPs per basis
predictions.pred_b_mlp4_writer_positive_control: MLP4 ranks in the top five of nine normalized upstream MLP writer capacities for has, is, and joint bases
predictions.pred_c_task_typed_weight_neighborhoods: has versus is top-six normalized upstream-head lists or top-six downstream value-reader lists differ by at least two entries
predictions.pred_d_zero_fit_zero_causal_leakage: zero forwards, backwards, updates, fitted scalars, and causal outcomes; rankings are discovery-only

terminal_rules.null: A and D pass but B or C fails

interpretation_limits: Weight incidence is structural capacity, not contextual causal effect.
Top-ranked components must be frozen in a new preregistration before causal testing.
The absence of a cosine>=0.80 shared state is not relabeled by a shared component ranking.
